name: Payment & Delivery Connections
summary: A centred headline over three alternating image-and-text rows (payment, logistics, marketplaces with a roadmap badge) and an endlessly scrolling, hover-paused partner logo marquee, with staggered scroll-in reveals.
useWhen: Showing which payment, courier and marketplace partners a product connects to, with a logo strip underneath
A white marketing section that needs partner rows with a status badge for what is still on the roadmap
avoidWhen: You only need a logo wall; use a simple logo cloud instead of the three-row layout
Partners must link out or be interactive; the rows and marquee are static content
source: own.uz (layout and motion reproduced, neutral brand)
